dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: It's my turn to play the guest, I see. A novel turn of events.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: I shall follow your lead, and play the good visitor.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Thank you for inviting me to this realm. This has proved a fine vacation spot.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Is a transfer of ownership on the cards, by any chance?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: No need to startle. This is a quiet and secure location, shielded from outside disturbances. It would make for a good backup base.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Any object that could solve many problems is worth paying a fair price for.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: An unfortunate answer, but not an unexpected one.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: This resembles a "home" more than it does a base. Let us keep it that way, then.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Speaking of "home"...

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Is something the matter?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: A fine suggestion. This space is sufficiently large for a family gathering.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The children will be glad to have the chance to visit and play at a friend's place. It is agreed, then... as for the costs of this gathering, simply leave it to me.

choices.text: All the children from the House of the Hearth would be welcome to come.
You want to buy the Serenitea Pot?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat?

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: That seems agreeable. Is there anything you would like to discuss?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The children often say so too.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: "I'm not sure what to say to 'Father,' what sort of topic I should go with..." I hear such discussions often.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: In truth, talking to me is not very difficult. I can make conversation on most topics.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: This is quite a specific engineering question. Your interest is unexpected.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The internal structure of an aquabus contains a number of intricate clockwork components, which allow it to be powered by different energy sources.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: I've also heard that during the aquabus's initial trial run, some passengers sent in feedback indicating that they would prefer a more unique look for the vessel.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, I would have never guessed...

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Some suggested that the vessels adopt an Angelic Sea Hare-like design, but this was rejected due to considerations for the vehicle's overall capabilities.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: If you would like to hear more about the history of the aquabus, I could arrange for a "friend" from the Fontaine Research Institute to explain it to you — during a boat ride, of course.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, you really can hold a conversation on just about anything!

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: But of course. Finding common topics and ground are indispensable assets in building interpersonal relations.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The work of intelligence gathering merits preparation, but it would be unwise to pin all one's hopes on intel. As such, I try to dabble in as many fields as I can to gain more knowledge.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Doesn't that get dry after a while?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Just the opposite. The more I learn, the more clearly I see how the world operates, and the easier it becomes to lead an elegant life.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: You must first take care of yourself before caring for others. Knowledge and skill broaden your options.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: If you have something you wish to share, feel free to come look for me. As long as nothing confidential is involved, I'm sure it will make for a wonderful chat.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Ah. It appears you quite enjoyed my choice of desserts for Miss Furina's table.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: There are many tricks to choosing treats. The key is having a sufficient "understanding" of everything.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The varieties of the treats, their stores of origin, the artisanship of their creators, as well as how they're plated and presented... Each of these factors builds upon the others. Still more intelligence is required if you are making this purchase on the behalf of another.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Their personalities, relationships, current situations, and long-held preferences... There is no one-size-fits-all answer.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds... really complicated.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: A novice would find it difficult, yes, but experience is cumulative. Start at buying gifts for friends and go from there.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: "The Unexpected Dream," you mean? I found it a mature production, a tale about love that blossomed through all manner of strange coincidences and circumstances.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: I watched the premiere. The actors were not sufficiently rehearsed, and incidents you'd expect from an unpolished production did occur, but the audience laughed and cheered them on all the same.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I've heard that they've brought on a famous actress to the upcoming show.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: That is indeed the case. If you are familiar with opera, you should know her. She was the protagonist in "Romaritime Romance" as well — you could say that she's at the peak of her career right now.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The fourth run of performances should start the day after tomorrow. If you're interested, I can invite you to come along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: The weather is good, as is the wind. Let us go for a walk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where shall we go?

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: There are two sights I enjoy more than most — the sea by day, and the skies by night.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: When I need to think, the former would be my choice. If I am in a good mood, then I will favor the latter.

choices.text: Why do you like the sea?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: I've rarely seen a Fontainian, native or adopted, not profess a fondness for the waves.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: It is full of mystery and peril, but also accepts all manner of wishes. Furthermore... the sea is vast, vast enough to serve as a repository for many kinds of frustrations.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm... so are you saying that gazing at the sea can improve your mood?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: No, I meant something more... literal than that. Namely, that the sea can make things that disgust you disappear, never to emerge again.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: It is good for secrets that should never see the light of day to sink to the forgotten depths.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds ominous...

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Only when your gaze can pierce through the sea's shimmering surface and look into its frigid depths, will you truly understand the truth of this world.

choices.text: Why do you like the night sky?

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Hmm... I suppose I could share a story from a long time ago.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: When I was young, I once had a dream. In it, I stood on a vast plain, with a red moon hanging in the sky.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The moon rotated gradually, and as I stared at it, it, too, watched me silently.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: I cannot describe what it was like to be the object of its gaze, so filled with death and grief... Or was it fear and pity? It has been too long, and my memories of it have faded.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: I wish to know as well, but the truth will not simply present itself to me.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: Perhaps I shall one day witness that dreamscape once more, or perhaps I never will. Just as you and I may cross blades one day — or perhaps our relations will remain ever amiable.

response.speaker: Arlecchino
response.text: The allure of the future lies in its uncertainty. Regardless, let us lay our worries aside and enjoy this fine breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Arlecchino.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: And to you. Ah, yes. Before turning in for the night, I noticed some corners of the realm that had not been cleaned for some time.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: You should see to that once the opportunity presents itself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Arlecchino.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Indeed. I was getting ready to retire myself.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: An early night is a balm for exhaustion, and presages a productive tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Many see me as a solitary, mysterious person.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: In truth, I do not mind mingling with the crowd. People-watching is also one of my interests.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Of course, whether those in the crowd would enjoy seeing me... is a completely different matter.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: If the world could be likened to a stage, then everyone must find their own place.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: I believe myself better suited to the audience stands. What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: Would you sit by my side, or would you prefer to take the stage?
